headline: One daughter shouldn't carry it alone.
sub: Put the whole family behind one small goal: keep the ring green.
content:
In most families one person quietly carries Mom — the reminders, the visits, the worry — while everyone else assumes it's handled.

GranWatch puts the whole family behind one small goal: keep the ring green. The brother in Australia sees it too. Anyone can be the one who goes.

Many hands make light work. This work included. granwatch.app/learn
